_rules: THE CONTROL FILE for every installed AI Hub. Each laptop reads this file on launch and compares 'version' to the build tag frozen into its own .exe. Same = do nothing. Different = download that installer, verify it, install it, reopen. 'retired' = delete the app and everything it put on the PC. The match is EXACT, so naming an older tag rolls the fleet back. An update also needs 'installer_url' and 'sha256'; while they are absent this file instructs nothing at all, which is the safe resting state it starts in. To roll a build out, tag it in the ai-hub repo, test the installer on one laptop, then replace this whole file with the JSON that build's CI run prints in its summary. To retire every laptop, replace this whole file with {"version": "retired", "passcode": "<the passcode in ai-hub/update.py>"}. 'notice' is an optional line shown in the Hub's status bar to laptops already on this version — use it to say something without changing anything. NEVER put anything secret in here: this repo is public on purpose, so that the retire signal can never be blinded by a token that was revoked or has expired. Full runbook: ai-hub/UPDATE-AND-RETIRE.md.
